Overview

A closer look

TrustGuard is nTrust.ai’s flagship security automation platform. It combines continuous vulnerability scanning, compliance validation, and policy enforcement in a single system that operates around the clock.

Designed for security and DevSecOps teams, TrustGuard gives you a defensible, audit-ready posture without adding headcount. Deploy in the cloud, or keep everything on-premise where data residency and control matter most.

Capabilities

What you get

⚡

Continuous Vulnerability Scanning

Cloud workloads and containers are scanned continuously; new risks are surfaced the moment they appear.

✅

Compliance Validation

Continuously validate controls against NIST AI RMF, ISO 27001, SOC 2 and the EU AI Act.

🔒

Zero-Trust Segmentation

Micro-segmentation and zero-trust policy enforcement limit lateral movement by default.

📦

Policy-as-Code Enforcement

Author, review and enforce security policy from version-controlled code, with full audit history.

🏢

On-Premise Option

Deploy inside your own environment for workloads with strict data-residency or sovereignty requirements.

🛡️

Supply-Chain Protection

Continuously monitor dependencies and artifacts for known vulnerabilities and integrity drift.

Who it’s for

  • Security teams that want continuous assurance instead of point-in-time snapshots.
  • DevSecOps organizations embedding checks into delivery pipelines.
  • Regulated enterprises preparing for NIST AI RMF, ISO 27001 or SOC 2 assessments.
  • Teams that need on-premise automation for data-sovereign workloads.

Compliance alignment

Every nTrust solution is engineered with enterprise-grade security from day one and maps to the frameworks your organization operates under:

  • NIST AI RMF (Govern, Map, Measure, Manage)
  • EU AI Act transparency & logging obligations
  • ISO 27001 and SOC 2 control alignment
  • GDPR and CCPA privacy requirements
